record.question: What are schedule H drugs?
options: Drugs that have high risk of overdose
Drugs that can be sold on prescription of a registered medical practitioner only
Drugs that have shorter shelf life
Drugs that have higher risk of teratogenicity
record.explanation: Answer B: Drugs that can be sold on prescription of a registered medical practitioner only. Schedule H medicines may be sold only on prescription of a registered medical practitioner, subject to the applicable labeling and sale rules. Reference: https://cdsco.gov.in/opencms/opencms/en/Acts-Rules/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
